alternatives.title: Minimal reversible slice
alternatives.summary: Implement only the accepted scope inside the allowed paths, without new infrastructure, persistence or IAM changes; verify in the target environment before anything else is added.
risks: may not cover the full business need on its own
state resets if the slice is stateless

alternatives.title: Defer / keep current process
alternatives.summary: Do not change the system now; keep the manual process and revisit when the unknowns are resolved.
risks: business impact of waiting is not quantified

alternatives.title: Managed object storage with short-lived signed URLs
alternatives.summary: Store objects in a private bucket and have the service authorize first, then issue short-lived signed URLs; needs retention, region and access-pattern inputs before its cost can be known.
risks: IAM and bucket policy must be provisioned outside the agent's scope

decision.rationale: Decision taken by William (founder-001) via Claude Cowork on 2026-09-21: smallest reversible slice, in-memory references only; storage-backed attachments deferred to a separate Change.
decision.objective: Let a reviewer attach up to three supporting evidence references (label + http(s) link) to an order exception before deciding, kept in memory next to the order, listed with the order in GET /api/orders and visible in the UI above the review buttons.
accepted_scope: at most three references per order
references listed with the order in GET /api/orders
references visible in the UI card above the review buttons
validation errors as JSON; the review note stays required

forbidden_actions: no change to review decision rules
